description: USE WHEN starting disease research. Lists the 15 disease domains with ontology ids (MONDO/EFO), indexed and active trial counts (active = recruiting, active or not yet recruiting) and ready links. Per-domain counts overlap because a trial can belong to more than one domain: for any overall total use totals.uniqueIndexedTrials / totals.uniqueActiveTrials and never sum the rows. NEXT: get_disease_dossier for therapies and biomarkers, get_disease_targets for genetic and functional target associations.
name: list_research_diseases
